signals.event: Public RFP/RFI issued seeking a transaction advisor or financial modeling support for a capital project/PPP
signals.archetype: Company entering a formal project financing or bid phase
signals.condition: Needs independent project finance advisory to build a bankable model, size debt, prepare an information memorandum, and support lender/investor dialogues
signals.why: A formal RFP indicates budget, urgency, and a defined mandate for external project finance expertise
signals.query: "Company Name" RFP OR RFI "transaction advisor" OR "financial advisor" "project finance"

signals.event: Announces target or achievement of Final Investment Decision (FID) for a major project
signals.archetype: Company transitioning from development into execution and financing close
signals.condition: Requires lender-case financial modeling, sensitivities, valuation support, and financing package finalization prior to financial close
signals.why: FID timing compresses financing workstreams and creates immediate demand for independent advisory and models acceptable to lenders
signals.query: "Company Name" "Final Investment Decision" OR FID project

signals.event: Signs a long-term offtake agreement or Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) for a new project
signals.archetype: Company de-risking project revenues and preparing for bankability
signals.condition: Needs revenue modeling, debt capacity analysis, and support in negotiating financing terms aligned with offtake/PPA provisions
signals.why: Commercial de-risking typically precedes or coincides with active project financing and lender engagement
signals.query: "Company Name" offtake agreement OR PPA project

signals.event: Forms a special purpose vehicle (SPV) or joint venture (JV) for project development
signals.archetype: Company structuring cash flows and governance for project financing
signals.condition: Requires project finance model, shareholder economics, risk allocation, and a financing strategy tailored to the SPV/JV
signals.why: SPV/JV formation is a leading indicator that the sponsor is preparing for non-recourse or limited-recourse financing
signals.query: "Company Name" SPV OR "special purpose vehicle" OR joint venture project

signals.event: Appoints a Head of Project Finance, VP Infrastructure Finance, or Treasurer with project finance background
signals.archetype: Company building internal capability to originate and close financed projects
signals.condition: New leader may seek external project finance advisors to accelerate pipeline validation, independent modeling, and lender market sounding
signals.why: Fresh leaders often initiate new mandates and partnerships to deliver early wins, creating near-term advisory opportunities
signals.query: "Company Name" "Head of Project Finance" OR "VP Infrastructure Finance" OR Treasurer appointed

signals.event: Announces intent to issue a green bond/project bond or raise non-recourse debt for a project
signals.archetype: Company arranging external capital for a capital-intensive project
signals.condition: Needs bank-grade models, valuation support, information memorandum, and analytics for lenders, investors, or rating agencies
signals.why: Capital markets processes demand rigorous, independent analysis and documentation under tight timelines
signals.query: "Company Name" "green bond" OR "project bond" OR "non-recourse" financing

signals.event: Publishes or is shortlisted for a PPP/concession tender where financial/transaction advisory is specified
signals.archetype: Company actively pursuing a regulated bid with defined submission requirements
signals.condition: Requires compliant bid models, value-for-money analysis, risk allocation, financing plan, and lender engagement support
signals.why: PPP bids are deadline-driven with explicit advisor requirements and budgeted bid costs
signals.query: "Company Name" PPP OR concession RFQ OR RFP "transaction advisor"

signals.event: Announces a greenfield manufacturing facility or energy project in an unfamiliar or emerging market
signals.archetype: Company entering new geography with large capital commitments and supply chain build-out
signals.condition: Needs market/demand validation, capex/opex modeling, incentives analysis, financing structure, and local lender mapping
signals.why: New-market capex drives the need for robust feasibility and financing strategies to de-risk commitments
signals.query: "Company Name" announces new plant OR greenfield project "project finance"

signals.event: Selects EPC contractor/OEM or completes FEED for a major capital project
signals.archetype: Company achieving technical definition and preparing for financing close
signals.condition: Needs to update bankable financial models to reflect contract terms, contingencies, and risk sharing acceptable to lenders
signals.why: Alignment of technical and financial cases is essential before lenders approve financing
signals.query: "Company Name" selects EPC OR "FEED completed" project

signals.event: Applies for or receives government grant/loan for a decarbonization, green hydrogen, or infrastructure project
signals.archetype: Company pursuing blended finance and moving toward bankability
signals.condition: Requires structuring to align grant/loan terms with debt and equity, plus reporting models and sensitivities
signals.why: Public funding often accelerates timelines and requires credible independent analysis to unlock private capital
signals.query: "Company Name" grant awarded OR "loan guarantee" decarbonization OR "green hydrogen" project

signals.event: Posts multiple openings for project finance analysts, financial modeling, or infrastructure investment roles
signals.archetype: Company scaling internal project finance capability
signals.condition: May need co-sourced modeling capacity, interim advisory support, and standardized templates while building the team
signals.why: Hiring surges signal active or upcoming deal flow and near-term capacity gaps that external advisors can fill
signals.query: "Company Name" "project finance analyst" OR "financial modeling" job

signals.event: Acquires or invests in a project pipeline, SPV, or developer
signals.archetype: Company expanding project portfolio requiring integration and financing
signals.condition: Needs valuation, offtake/PPA assessment, refinancing strategy, and consolidation of financial models
signals.why: M&A triggers compressed diligence and financing workstreams ideal for external transaction advisory
signals.query: "Company Name" acquires project pipeline OR developer infrastructure

signals.event: Publishes a multi-year capital expenditure plan or capital allocation update citing major projects
signals.archetype: Company committing to a portfolio of capital-intensive initiatives
signals.condition: Requires portfolio modeling, scenario analysis, and multi-project financing strategy and sequencing
signals.why: A defined capex roadmap creates sustained demand for advisory across feasibility, valuation, and financing
signals.query: "Company Name" "capital expenditure" plan OR "capex program" investor presentation

signals.event: Announces specific decarbonization projects (e.g., green hydrogen pilot or renewable capacity addition) with timelines
signals.archetype: Company initiating transition projects that require dedicated financing structures
signals.condition: Needs techno-economic assessments, bankable financial models, blended finance strategy, and offtake economics
signals.why: Transition projects often have complex funding stacks and benefit from independent modeling to meet investor/lender requirements
signals.query: "Company Name" green hydrogen pilot OR decarbonization project "project finance"

accounts.description: Tamasuk is a diversified infrastructure developer, investor, and asset owner focused primarily on Saudi Arabia. It partners with procurement authorities, governments, EPC contractors, financial institutions, and investors to develop, finance, deliver, and operate complex infrastructure across social, utility, and digital sectors. Through Tamasuk Operations and Facilities Management (TOFM), oversees asset performance under long-term operations arrangements to maintain reliability, continuity, contractual compliance, asset longevity, and long-term portfolio value.
